title: File:NASA Missions Probe What May Be a 1-In-10,000-Year Gamma-ray Burst (SVS14317 - Mars burst).gif

title: File:Testing for the Katalyst-NASA Swift Boost Mission (SVS15044 - IMG 0010).jpg
desc: The LINK spacecraft descends into the Space Environment Simulator at NASA Goddard on April 28, 2026. The SES recreates the hot and cold temperature extremes LINK will experience in space. Engineers tested Swift in the same chamber before it launched in November 2004.
